changes.title: Sigils bigger
items: The sigils in your stack and over the rune stones are half as big again, so you can tell which animal each one is

changes.title: Station backdrop
items: At a station the room behind the witch goes darker, so she stands out

changes.title: Sigil motes
items: The motes rising off sigils and runestones are bigger, brighter and rise higher, so they read in the dark; a crowd of sigils thins its own so it doesn't turn to noise

changes.title: Contrast
items: The forest is darker where nothing lights it, so the lit places, the creatures and their sigils stand out
The edge pointers sit on a dark backing and in stronger colour, so they're easier to spot
